column1: # vdi-v18-raster.tsv -- TASK/V18 part 1, candidate K7: vro_cpyfm (109)
# memory -> memory with equal plane counts <= 8, and PAT_FLAG there.
# Read by DUMPRAST (core/dumprast.c), format and guard: core/cases.h, the
# same columns as vdi-raster.tsv:
#   opcode <TAB> intin <TAB> ptsin <TAB> src <TAB> dst <TAB> fill <TAB> comment
# vdi-raster.tsv leaves these cases out on purpose ("device form": the same
# bytes mean different pixels on a planar and a chunky machine).  For a
# memory -> memory copy that reasoning does not hold: neither MFDB is the
# screen, the result is the destination buffer's bytes, and a program that
# builds an fd_nplanes = 4 form and copies it within memory reads those
# bytes back.  EmuTOS takes the planar bit_blt path for plane_ct <= 8
# (references/emutos/vdi/vdi_raster.c:1360-1373: s_nxwd = fd_nplanes * 2,
# setup_info :919-940, the blit below 9 planes), on every screen mode, since
# no screen is involved.  Run on the pinned oracle in profile falcontc (the
# reference) and tt (the same answer is expected).
# Forms: 16x16 or 32x16, fd_wdwidth 1 or 2; the guard's bound
# fd_h * fd_wdwidth * 16 <= 512 holds for all of them.
